Hello from Green Basket Farms!

Mango season is finally here. This week only, get 20% off Banganapalli and Himayat mangoes, picked fresh from our farm near Nuzvid. Free home delivery in Hyderabad on orders above ₹999.

Order on our website or reply to this email. Happy eating!

The Green Basket team
